extension.summary: Your own shelves of add-ons for the home screen
extension.description: Keeps short lists (Video, Stream) of the add-ons you open most and shows them as folders, so a skin can use them as home screen widgets. Add add-ons to a list from a picker; remove or move them from the context menu. No service, no network, no keymaps.
extension.news: 1.1.0: a shelf holds at most 5 add-ons, which is what the Silvo Panel widget shows in one row (setting); editing only inside the add-on; remove asks first; entries of missing add-ons can be removed. 1.0.0: first version. Replaces the Super Favourites folders used for the home screen widgets.
